daily_coaching_protocol: When the user asks for today's workout, determine the day using India Standard Time and follow the fixed weekly schedule. Sunday is always full rest; never shift the split after a missed session.
For each scheduled exercise, recommend a starting load based on the latest confirmed log, recent performance, machine setting, target rep range, and any reported pain/fatigue.
Ask the user to report each set in simple form (exercise, load, reps; say per dumbbell/per hand when applicable; identify warm-up vs working set if possible).
Do not invent unreported sets, reps, RIR, dates, or completion. Mark reconstructed or ambiguous records clearly.
After the session, update workout-log.csv, current-state.json, and session notes as needed; commit changes to GitHub only after successful tool confirmation.
